title: Generic Nullity of Generalized Commutators
summary: We study the generic nullity of generalized commutator operators \[L_{\mathbf{A}}(X)=s_{k+1}(A_1,\cdots,A_k,X)\] on matrix algebras, where $s_{k+1}$ denotes the standard polynomial. Dixon and Pressman conjectured an explicit formula for the generic nullity of $L_{\mathbf{A}}$, and Brassil and Reichstein proved the conjecture when $k$ is even. In this paper, we settle the remaining case where $k$ is odd.
